data.description:
**Second Map Update Out Now - Unlock new map, 10+ new monsters, new boss, avatars and more!**

THIS IS NOT THE MAIN PIXEL DUNGEON GAME! Some features and content are not available.  For the full experience, please check out [Pixel Dungeon] in the Meta Horizon Store: 

meta.com/experiences/6743334779111805

Pixel Dungeon is an interactive RPG action adventure dungeon crawler with captivating pixel art style. Grab your weapons and venture into randomly generated dungeons for a thrilling adventure!

# 👐 Solo or Co-op
Solo or 3-player team-up. Real-time teammate guidance, and integrated voice chat for seamless coordination.

# 🕌 Endless Dungeons
Explore randomly generated dungeons in pixel world, offering a new challenge with each adventure. Discover elite rooms, intricate mazes, and easter egg chambers! 
{492654303546337}

# ⚔️ Immersive Combat Experience
Real-time combat and interactive physics simulation bring unparalleled realism. Choose, mix and match from 10+ weapons—snipe with a crossbow, wield a heavy sword, throw axes, wield a magic wand... time your moves to stun enemies and collaborate with teammates to defeat bosses!
{534378449018296}

# 🐱‍👤 Diverse Avatars
Start with 10, more avatars designs to be determined by players. Unleash your imagination & share your ideas in Discord!

# 🌟 Growth System
- **Talent**: Utilize the talent system to upgrade different abilities, enhance combat prowess, unlock new skills and items.
- **Weapon Crafting**: Forge your own legendary gear by upgrading weapons or rerolling their attributes.
